candidate_state_construction.initial_invariant: lm_head.weight and model.embed_tokens.weight must be the same parameter and storage immediately after model load
candidate_state_construction.separation_rule: Before any weight quantization, replace lm_head.weight with a detached byte-identical clone and leave model.embed_tokens.weight on its original parameter and storage.
candidate_state_construction.post_separation_invariant: lm_head.weight and model.embed_tokens.weight must have different storage addresses while their BF16 bytes still match.
candidate_state_construction.weight_quantization_rule: Apply the authenticated signed-W4 per-output-row Scale32 rule to all 168 transformer Linear weights and the separated lm_head weight; never write through model.embed_tokens.weight.
candidate_state_construction.post_quantization_embedding_invariant: The complete model.embed_tokens.weight BF16 byte stream must retain SHA-256 4e96b0df6d274768cbb7e72404011853d23349999b658dc2f4dfb3c431ea223f.
candidate_state_construction.post_quantization_lm_head_invariant: lm_head uses the authenticated packed-W4 plus per-output-row Scale32 representation derived from the same raw tied BF16 source.
candidate_state_construction.hardware_semantics: This separated-use host state matches the existing package: host/runtime embedding preload reads raw BF16 model.embed_tokens rows, while the accelerator image contains a distinct packed-W4 lm_head region.

position_classes.prompt: positions one through original prompt length minus one
position_classes.decode: positions at or beyond the original prompt length

table_derivation_order: construct the exact alias-safe post-W4 candidate state
run only the frozen non-evaluator calibration and preflight prompts
collect per-layer, per-event, per-position-class, per-group absolute maxima
encode each maximum divided by 127 with the smallest covering normalized Scale32 record
freeze the resulting table and its hash
reload a fresh exact alias-safe post-W4 candidate and replay every non-evaluator prompt against the frozen table

additional_preflight_prompts: Name one primary color in one lowercase word.
Return only the integer result of 9 multiplied by 7.
In five words, describe gentle rain.
Answer yes or no: Is water wet?

official_attempt_contract.authorization_rule: A replacement bounded Engineer mission must separately authorize exactly one new attempt after all preflight artifacts and hashes are frozen.
official_attempt_contract.generation: deterministic greedy argmax; no sampling; use_cache=false; maximum six generated tokens; termination IDs 151643 and 151645
official_attempt_contract.score_policy: binary only: 9/9 complete token arrays exactly equal BF16 and 9/9 response-gate outcomes equal BF16
official_attempt_contract.on_evaluator_no_execution: preserve the consumed attempt, classify separately, and draw no numerical correctness conclusion

acceptance_matrix.case: alias separation, exact post-W4 table derivation, and fresh-model replay over all frozen non-evaluator prompts
acceptance_matrix.expected: all identity, coverage, and zero-overflow checks pass before any attempt marker exists

acceptance_matrix.case: embedding bytes change, tied storage remains after separation, official prompts are used for calibration/preflight, or a marker exists before preflight passes
acceptance_matrix.expected: fail without creating or consuming official attempt authority

acceptance_matrix.case: the frozen official attempt starts but no candidate prompt completes
acceptance_matrix.expected: authorization remains consumed, numerical conclusion remains null, and replay is forbidden

acceptance_matrix.case: one or more candidate prompt results complete but the 9/9 binary gate is not met
acceptance_matrix.expected: eligible=false, selected_policy_id=null, exact disagreements preserved, and no downstream authority

acceptance_matrix.case: all nine complete token arrays and all nine response-gate outcomes match BF16
acceptance_matrix.expected: prepare immutable Fresh Reviewer input; do not select the policy or advance stages before independent acceptance
